title: Retaliation Hardening
acceptance: An error inside the retaliation tick is caught and warned; every pursuit is finished (pursuers roam and can be inspected again) and the loop keeps running.
An erroring onFled handler is caught and warned, and the fled monster still falls back to the slipped-away removal unless a handler took it.
A fled capture clears that player's saved counters on the monster, so a retry on a monster that retaliated starts at 0 hits and 0 misses (jg, 2026-10-12).

The Retaliation scenario checks containment with the player just outside the hub edge and within the give-up distance (pursuit still running, pursuers inside the habitat footprint), and a death ending (Health 0 -> pursuersOf empty).
setPursuing(nil)'s Inspect re-enable assumption is commented. Retaliation, FullLoop and ExploitProbe pass; scripts/check.sh passes.
